name: Hourglass of Held Breath
summary: An hourglass that freezes the world for a moment while you act.
description: The sand never runs out and never settles. Those who carry it dislike being near clocks.

stats.effect: As a Magic action, you can turn the hourglass over to cast *Time Stop* from it. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until the next dawn.
